missing_algorithms: No multi-factor scoring algorithm for tier recommendation — only employee count is used; no weighted combination of farm size, sensor density, data volume, compliance needs
No module dependency graph or topological sort — modules are returned as a flat list with no ordering constraints or prerequisite resolution
No gradual rollout / canary percentage algorithm for feature flags
No backward-compatibility or migration algorithm for onboarding state when tiers change
No heuristic or ML-based tier refinement — no feedback loop to adjust thresholds based on actual usage patterns
No recommendation explanation algorithm — recommend_tier returns a bare string with no reasoning, confidence, or alternative-tier suggestions
No per-module completion estimation algorithm (time, cost, complexity scoring)
No dependency resolution algorithm for inter-module prerequisites (e.g., 'analytics' requires 'sensors' to be configured first)
bottlenecks: Hard-coded magic-number thresholds (10, 500) in OrganizationProfiler with no named constants or config-driven override — requires code change to adjust boundaries
Revenue parameter is accepted but silently dead — test_revenue_ignored confirms it has zero effect; either remove it or wire it into scoring
ModuleRegistry uses a static dict — adding a tier or module requires editing source code; no plugin/registry extension point
No caching of tier lookups or module lists; repeated calls rebuild data (trivial now, becomes real with dynamic registries)
Flat module list with no lazy loading — all modules for a tier are always returned even if the user only needs a subset
No async/concurrent module initialization — onboarding wizard would block on each module setup sequentially
examples/onboarding_demo.py is broken: references tier='starter' (nonexistent) and fields=10 (unknown param) — demo cannot run
test_all_recommended_modules_importable only asserts module_name.isidentifier() — it is a name-shape check, not an actual import or smoke test; gives false confidence
benchmark_gaps: No guided setup wizard: no step-by-step interactive flow, no progress tracking, no skip/resume, no per-step validation
No configuration templates: no per-tier YAML/JSON config scaffolds, no .env generation, no config validation or schema
No feature flags: no per-tier feature toggles, no gradual rollout, no experimentation framework, no kill-switch
No dependency management: no inter-module dependency graph, no external service dependency declarations (DB, MQ, object store), no health checks or readiness probes
No onboarding state persistence: no database or file-backed store for tracking which steps are completed across sessions
No onboarding API: no REST/gRPC endpoints for programmatic access to tier recommendation or module listing
No onboarding CLI: no `agtech onboard init` / `agtech onboard status` command
No metrics or telemetry: no instrumentation to track onboarding completion rates, drop-off points, or module setup duration
No multi-language or accessibility support in onboarding flow
No A/B testing framework for onboarding variants
No rollback or undo mechanism for completed onboarding steps
No notification/reminder system for incomplete onboarding steps
No integration with identity providers (SSO, OAuth) for enterprise onboarding
No data import/migration tooling for existing farms transitioning into the platform
